title: Chapter 599
paragraphs: Chapter 599
Episode 156. Purification of Chaos (3)
'It was a similar feeling to when I faced Ron, who had fallen into demonic transformation...'
He had a similar experience in the abyss of Glic. At that time, Jin felt his power grow as chaos and spirit energy intermingled.
That power seemed to have disappeared after the fight with Ron, who fell into demonic transformation, but it remains as a blemish in the form of erosion, tormenting Jin.
His heart was pounding as if it would explode.

Jin couldn't hear the voices of the brothers surrounding him and Teto. His head was buzzing as if submerged in water, and yet his senses had become strangely sharp, forming an unwanted fighting spirit.
Despite nearly inflicting a fatal wound on his brother, he still felt the desire to continue fighting.

It was not easy to suppress that feeling, as if he were under the influence of a powerful drug. If the people in front of him weren't his brothers but strangers, he might not have been able to stop his sword.
Since the Sword Emperor's War, Jin hadn't faced an opponent strong enough to awaken the demon. The battle with Qwaul was just a warm-up, so he hadn't experienced this state.
Good and evil, path and heresy, light and dark.
Such opposing desires were causing rough waves within Jin.
He thought he had barely suppressed it, but the energy of the demon wriggled like a ferocious snake.
'If I use this power, I can reach a transcendental state in an instant...'
There could be no sweeter story for a martial artist.
He felt that if he just decided to 'do so' once, an unfathomable power would fill his entire body like a flood.
He felt as if someone had bestowed a blessing upon him. He felt that even the uncontrollable nature of demonic transformation would disappear if he fully accepted that power.
'Why should I refuse?'
When his stream of consciousness reached that point, Jin's demonic transformation amplified even further.
He could no longer hear the voices of his brothers, even as a blurred sensation. Even the figures of his brothers appeared as black figures.
He was regretful that he had sheathed his sword so quickly.
The brothers, who began to appear as black figures, started to feel threatening. He felt he needed to protect himself from those demon-like beings immediately.
"Kuaak...!"
Jin let out a cry and shook off a hand extended by one of his brothers. It was Beliz's hand.
If she wasn't a Warlord of the Myungwang tribe, her hand would have been cut off or ripped off because he had swung with all his might. Beliz, without panicking, grabbed Jin again.
Beliz's strength was among the top in the Warlords. Yet, she had to put all her strength into holding Jin's arm.
"Hold Brother Jin down!"

The other Warlords also joined in to subdue him. The reason they could keep Jin under control despite being hit with fists and kicks filled with monstrous strength was because they were the Myungwang Warlords.
"Brother, snap out of it!"
The subjugation continued in a very rough manner. They had no choice but to break his arms and legs, and even had to suppress him so strongly that his body was on the verge of collapsing.
Despite coughing up blood and screaming, Jin showed signs of instant recovery. Moreover, his strength increased each time he recovered.

Several of the regular brothers closed their eyes tightly as if they couldn't bear to watch the harsh subjugation continue. It was hard to withstand seeing a brother's body being broken by their own kind.
Jin had to stop himself. There was a limit to the suppression by the kings. There was no telling how much Jin's body could take.
"Brother Jin!"
"Cough, choke...!"
Soon, Jin stopped rampaging, coughing up black blood. At the last moment when the devilish aura was at its peak, his bloodline once again held him back.
Even after that, the kings couldn't let go of Jin for a while. They all felt like they were holding a bomb that could explode at any time.
"Are, are you okay?"
Jin, lying down, looked up at the worried faces of his brothers. It was then that the brothers let out a sigh of relief, but Jin felt as if his heart was breaking with remorse.
"My brothers..."
"Kekeke, Brother Jin. Don't feel guilty!"
Among the brothers who were trying to find the right words, Teto shouted first.

"That's toxic. Your inner self? Heart? Anyway, it's not in a good state right now, and if you're wrapped up in guilt, you'll naturally weaken, right? Then naturally, the will to push back the erosion of chaos will weaken. So, for efficiency's sake, you need to get rid of that kind of emotion."
"Oh, what a plausible thing to say for the Twelfth King. Has the hard work of the Second King finally paid off?"
"The Twelfth King is right. You need to find mental stability, Brother Jin."
Jin nodded after a few seconds of making eye contact with his brothers.
Instead of guilt, he decided to only feel gratitude. The reason he could so easily feel such a thing, even after nearly killing a brother and causing trouble, was simple.
Among brothers, favors are not calculated.
Jin was also a person who followed the order of the Myungwang Clan. If the targets he had almost harmed were other colleagues, it would not have been easy for him to feel light-hearted.
"Phew, thank you. My brothers."
"Here, have a glass of cold water."
"Right, think simply, simply. We can handle Brother Jin like this, what would've happened if it were someone else?"
"I don't know how many times my arms and legs have been broken."
"Well, when we first came, they were cut off dozens of times. In a way, it's better than back then."
Jin and the Myungwang Clan lightened the mood instead of getting serious. Then, Jin felt the remnants of his devilish aura quickly subside.
The Myungwang Clan was not experiencing a case like Jin's for the first time. They knew exactly that the mental aspect had the most significant influence on the devilish aura.
"Brother Jin."
"Yes, Brother Il-Two-Wang."
"Think of this as rehabilitation training. You just stumbled once, and you can stumble many more times in the future."
Baltirock put his hand on Jin's shoulder.
"What you need to do each time, is just shake it off and get up quickly like now. You shouldn't worry about why you fell, or if you hurt anyone while falling."
"And what we need to do is to continually lend a hand and help you up each time you fall."
"It's amazing, Brother Teto keeps making the right points...?"
Jin nods his head.
Having such lovable and reliable brothers, having a home, was such a good thing.
"So... pick up your sword and get ready again."
It was only a few minutes ago that he nearly stabbed Teto. The brothers seemed completely unconcerned about that.
"Do you mean right now?"
"You shouldn't be afraid of going berserk again. The Tushin brothers must have foreseen this situation, and yet they told us to check your skills and condition."
"That means the Tushin brothers trust Brother Jin like the other brothers, and probably nothing will happen even if you continue to go berserk...?"
"Probably, you say?"
While it was true that he loved and trusted his brothers very much, Jin was sometimes taken aback by this insensitive aspect of the Myungwang Clan.
"Brother Tantel! Run and ask the Tushin brothers. Ask if we can continue given the situation."
At Garmund's words, Tantel left the training ground. Tantel returned quickly and nodded his head.
"They say to continue!"
"Well then, that's it. Thinking about it, we might have made a fuss. The Tushin brothers told us to do it."
"Right, right. Since the Tushin brothers told us to do it, there will be no problem, right?"
"But, everyone seems unsure. Are you sure it's okay?"
"Who was next in line? The person who won rock-paper-scissors? Ah, it was me!"
"Brother Garmund, you're lying. After the Twelve-Two-Wang brothers, it was the Yi-Two-Wang brothers. Then it was the Baltirock brothers, and the rest... Damn, what was the order?"
"Since we can't remember it anyway, let's invalidate it and decide again with rock-paper-scissors."
"Are we going to keep being left out? The Two-Wang brothers."

"Hey, you still want to participate after seeing the situation? The regular fighters should just watch until Jin's chaos is purified. On the other hand, let the audience watch from a closer distance. We need to suppress Jin quickly if he goes berserk again."
There was no time to refuse. Jin continued the duel with his sword Sigmund in hand.
The duel continued for three more days.
During that time, Jin constantly clashed with the Two-Wang brothers, except when he was sleeping (even then, they slept together in the training ground to be prepared for any berserk incidents).
And he experienced over twenty episodes of going berserk.
During the worst episode, he caused enough chaos to destroy half of the training ground, while the mildest one ended with him getting hit in the chin twice.
'I have no energy left in my body...'
The duel had been so intense that even the chaos felt drained of energy. It seemed like he didn't even have the strength to go berserk.
It wasn't the end of the devilish aura.
Just as Dante had opened the door to Gleyak's temptation, there was always a window that could be opened in Jin's heart.
It was a tempting door that promised he could be comfortable and stronger if he just opened it.
The Two-Wang brothers were also showing signs of exhaustion. They not only had to duel but also had to hold onto Jin every time he went berserk, so they couldn't help but be tired.
'If I hadn't heard about the temptation of chaos from Dante... And if I hadn't experienced the tragic story of the Sword Emperor City. I might have opened that window by now.'
His teeth chattered, making a grinding sound. Jin reached out with his trembling hand and grasped his sword again.
"Who's... Who's next?"

The Two-Wang brothers avoided Jin's gaze while clearing their throats. Those who had been so eager to fight were now subtly trying to pass the turn to one another. The regular fighters urged the Two-Wang brothers to come forward as if they were watching a fire from the other side of the river.
Finally, as Teto, the youngest of the Two-Wang brothers, tried to get up with his battered body, a voice of salvation came from the other side of the training ground.
"The chaos extraction assist device is complete, brothers!"
It was the voice of O-Two-Wang Boras. He was also covered in black soot, as if something had happened while he was making the extraction assist device.
The Two-Wang brothers were about to greet Boras with relief, thinking they could finally rest, but they straightened their posture after seeing the stern gaze of Tushin Vahn standing next to him.
And then Vahn threw this single sentence.
"Keep going, brothers."
